messages:
Priya Shah: Quick heads-up — draft outreach for tenants affected by last night's VPC onboarding webhook failures. 24 tenants impacted (segmented below). Repair completed 03:45 UTC. Draft email + office hours invite included. Need quick review of credit calc + technical phrasing before send. @Marco Li @Ben Torres

Marco Li: Confirmed numbers: 24 tenants total — 6 enterprise/high-touch, 10 mid-market, 8 SMB. Proposed credits: enterprise = 10% of monthly committed spend, mid-market = 5% monthly, SMB = one-time $200 credit. Spreadsheet with per-tenant numbers: https://redwood.fake/incident/1945678901/credits

Ben Torres: Root cause summary: regression in webhook auth token refresh job when KMS key rotation occurred — tokens were not refreshed for the VPC onboarding path. Mitigation: rolled back the new refresh path and deployed hotfix (rolled at 03:45 UTC). Added a backfill job to retry pending webhooks and added alerting for token-refresh failures.

Elena Gomez: Outreach copy (short) below — will personalize per tenant. Subject: "Important: Onboarding delivery issue resolved — next steps and support"
```
Hi <CustomerName>,
We experienced an onboarding webhook delivery issue between 02:15–03:02 UTC that affected some initial file syncs. The issue is resolved — we rolled back the change and ran a hotfix plus replayed pending webhooks.
We're offering account credits and live enablement office hours to help complete any pending onboarding steps.
If you'd like immediate help, reply or join the office hours.
Best,
The Redwood Inference Team
```

Priya Shah: Also proposing a two-question feedback survey after outreach. Survey: https://forms.redwood.internal/1945678901-feedback — quick CS + product signal. Office hours proposal: Thu 15:00 UTC (60m). Can we add EU/APAC local times?

Marco Li: EU friendly slot 09:00 CET and APAC slot 02:00 AEST are fine. I'll create calendar invites and publish RSVP links. Will share attendee list so CS can prioritize enterprise seats.

Ben Torres: For any tenant still seeing errors, workaround for CSEs/SREs: run queued replay via internal API: `POST /internal/tenants/{tenant_id}/webhook/replay` (requires elevated perms). I'll add runbook steps and a short verifier script to the incident page.

Elena Gomez: Renewal/ae note: Flag accounts with >3 failed onboarding attempts as 'At-risk' and loop in AE for 48h follow-up. I'll prepare a one-pager with talking points to reduce churn risk.

Priya Shah: Draft email + credit table are attached in the sheet. Ready to send once we get the greenlight. @Marco Li confirm the credit amounts noted above and that they match the spreadsheet totals. @Ben Torres confirm monitoring hooks are in place to detect any re-occurrence.

ops-bot: Incident INC-1945678901 created — Severity: P2. Runbook: webhook-retry-run. Incident page: https://incidents.redwood/1945678901

Marco Li: Credits confirmed and committed in the spreadsheet. Target send time: 1300 UTC to affected tenants. Sequence: call enterprise accounts first (Elena), then email + credits for mid/SMB.

Elena Gomez: I'll call the 6 enterprise accounts now. Voicemail template left in the doc: `Hi <Name>, quick note from Redwood: we resolved a delivery issue that may have impacted your onboarding. We want to offer hands-on help and credits — can we schedule 30m today?`

Priya Shah: Approved to send at 1300 UTC. Send owners: Elena (calls + email send), Marco (credits + calendar invites), Ben (monitoring + runbook updates). After send I'll post a simplified copy to #customer-templates and attach the feedback link. :thumbsup:

Ben Torres: Postmortem ETA: EOD tomorrow. Will include timeline, root cause, and long-term mitigations (additional KMS rotation testing in staging, token-refresh unit tests, and synthetic checks on onboarding flow).

Priya Shah: Thanks — once emails are out Elena please paste the final email copy here and ping AEs for handoffs. I'll compile a short executive note for leadership.

Elena Gomez: Will do. Adding follow-up: quick CS->AE handoff doc ready in 15m.

Marco Li: Calendar invites sent, RSVP sheet updated.

Priya Shah: Closing coordination thread — sending at 1300 UTC. We'll capture feedback and reconvene after office hours to triage sticky customers.
